ida: quick check-in: i ran a short canary that combines tenant-budgeted probabilistic demote + a tiny local rehydrate buffer. baseline: reduce token egress without breaking R/W guarantees. results below.

chris: top-line numbers?

ida: on 4 multi-tenant hosts over 3h: token egress -10.1%, overall origin hits +1.8%. two micro-tenants saw transient origin spikes (~+6%) that correlated with undersampling.

anjali: undersampling -> R/W risk. what safety checks do we have?

ida: three layered guards:
1) ownership_fence: demote only if ownership_state==STABLE from local cache (with min_age_ms=250)
2) recent_write_pin: any prefix with last_write < write_pin_ttl (default 45s) is pinned
3) tenant_eviction_budget: track evicts/min and back off if budget exceeded

chris: implementation pseudocode?

ida: ```
for prefix in active_prefixes:
  if !ownership_cache.is_stable(prefix) or ownership_cache.age_ms(prefix) < min_age_ms:
    blocked('ownership')
    continue
  if now - prefix.last_write_ms < write_pin_ttl:
    blocked('recent_write')
    continue
  prob = compute_prob(prefix, tenant_budget)
  if rand() < prob and tenant_budget.allow(tenant):
    soft_demote(prefix)
```

anjali: good. how do we tune prob for small tenants to avoid noisy demotes?

ida: we use a Bayesian shrink toward a global mean and require min_sample_count before allowing prob>0.2. also we expose a per-tenant shrink alpha in flags.

chris: what telemetry did you add?

ida: demote_eval_total, demote_allowed, demote_blocked_ownership, demote_blocked_pin, demote_to_origin_count (per-tenant), demote_prob_histogram. added an alert: if demote_to_origin_count increases >4% sustained 15m for any tenant, auto-scale demote_prob down 3x for that tenant and page.

anjali: logs snippet?

ida: (sanitized)
```
[2026-07-12T09:12:01Z] demote_eval: prefix=cfg_7 tenant=alpha prob=0.18 draw=0.13 -> demote (ownership=true age_ms=310 last_write_age=62000)
[2026-07-12T09:12:02Z] rehydrate_lru: miss->origin prefix=cfg_7 latency=78ms
[2026-07-12T09:12:05Z] demote_blocked: prefix=tmp_11 reason=recent_write last_write=2026-07-12T09:12:01.900Z
```

chris: observed races between ownership updates and demote tick?

ida: one case: ownership cache stale by ~180ms, allowed demote on a node while another node was mid-handoff. mitigations: increase min_age_ms to 400 for nodes with high gossip lag and add a quick quorum-bit check for critical prefixes.

anjali: rehydrate buffer details?

ida: per-node LRU of 128 entries, soft_rehydrate_ttl=12s. purpose: absorb short flaps so a demote->miss->origin spike is rare. we measured rehydrate_lru_hit_rate ~0.62 for demoted prefixes in the canary.

chris: testing plan before broader rollout?

ida: unit tests for ownership_token semantics, property tests interleaving writes/handoffs/demotes, deterministic replay for stochastic paths, 48h canary at 1% multi-tenant hosts then ramp. Dedicated pools excluded.

ops-bot: deploybot: canary scheduled -> group=prob-demote-lru-canary hosts=canary-1..canary-6 start=2026-07-13T03:00:00Z :rocket:

anjali: please include a dashboard link and ensure alerting on demote_to_origin_count is pinned. also add a per-tenant slowdown if origin_reads increase >5% within 10m.

ida: will do. opening PR with flags and metrics now.
